rule: Manoj's source rule (buildwith, 4 Oct 2026 IST): official sources first (organiser, government, tourism board, governing body, UNESCO). Non-official sources only if the event community widely accepts them, with evidence (source_type community-accepted, why_accepted recorded). No blogs, SEO travel guides, listing sites, newspapers as primary sources, travel agencies or commercial sellers. Every external link on buildwith.curiosta.com must be on a domain listed here; test-all.js fails otherwise. Hosts are matched exactly after dropping a leading 'www.'.
